title: Slow Caramel with Explicit Completion Criteria

materials.label: smooth salted caramel sauce with a deep amber finish

operations.label: dissolve the sugar without stirring
operations.until: every visible crystal has disappeared from both the syrup and the inner wall of the pan, and the liquid is completely transparent when viewed against a white spatula

operations.label: caramelize while swirling occasionally
operations.until: the syrup is an even deep amber from edge to center, gives off the first faint thread of smoke, and has not developed any dark bitter spots

operations.label: carefully whisk in dairy and seasoning
operations.action: carefully whisk in dairy and seasoning
operations.until: bubbling has subsided, every piece of butter is incorporated, and a spoonful cools to a thick ribbon that remains smooth rather than grainy
